# Zen Mesh — Webhook Operations

> Zen Mesh helps teams receive, validate, observe, and operate webhooks across Stripe, GitHub, and custom sources. Current readiness is DEMO only (local/mock/sandbox and limited cloud-demo scope — not customer-ready or production-live).

Version: 1.0.0 · Last-Updated: 2026-05-30 · Product scope: webhook ingestion, validation, delivery visibility, and security operations.

Non-claims and proof scope are authoritative — see the Non-Claims and Wedge Evidence links below before inferring production readiness.

## Core

- [Website](https://www.zen-mesh.io): Public product site
- [Documentation](https://docs.zen-mesh.io): Docs hub (this site)
- [Source repository](https://github.com/zenmesh/zen-platform): Contracts and internal evidence source of truth

## Wedge evidence (high signal)

- [Wedge claim map](https://docs.zen-mesh.io/ai/evidence/v1/wedge-claim-map.json): Scoped capability claims for the webhook wedge
- [Wedge non-claims](https://docs.zen-mesh.io/ai/evidence/v1/wedge-non-claims.json): What the wedge does not claim
- [Wedge overview](https://docs.zen-mesh.io/docs/ai/wedge-overview): Narrative wedge summary for reviewers

- [Capability manifest](https://docs.zen-mesh.io/ai/evidence/v1/manifest.json): Machine-readable capability and proof_status registry
